name: Boardwalk Pavillion , First Monday
summary: Boardwalk Pavilion is a covered shopping venue within Canton's historic First Monday Trade Days complex, offering climate-controlled browsing alongside amenities like a wine bar, coffee shop, and diner. This popular destination combines the excitement of flea market shopping with modern conveniences, drawing bargain hunters and collectors from across the region.
demographics: Boardwalk Pavilion at First Monday attracts a diverse mix of bargain hunters and antique enthusiasts, primarily middle-income families and retirees from the Canton area and surrounding East Texas communities. The trade area draws heavily from rural and small-town populations within a 50-mile radius who appreciate value-oriented shopping and the unique flea market atmosphere. Visitors tend to be budget-conscious shoppers seeking deals on everything from home goods to collectibles, with peak attendance during the famous First Monday Trade Days events that have served the region since 1873.
description: Boardwalk Pavilion at First Monday is a unique shopping destination located in Canton, Texas, that serves as part of the legendary First Monday Trade Days complex, one of the oldest and largest flea markets in the United States. This covered pavilion offers shoppers a climate-controlled environment to browse for bargains and treasures, complementing the outdoor vendor areas that have made Canton famous since 1873. Inside the pavilion, visitors will find a wine bar, coffee shop, and diner, providing convenient refreshment options during their shopping excursions. The center operates with extended hours during Trade Days weekends, typically from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, attracting thousands of visitors from across Texas and beyond who come to experience the thrill of discovering unique finds and negotiating deals. With its blend of permanent vendors and rotating merchants, Boardwalk Pavilion has earned a solid 4.6-star rating from over 270 reviews, cementing its reputation as an essential stop for anyone visiting the Canton First Monday Trade Days experience.
